subject: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Thompson <jane.thompson@acme.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks

Hi Jane —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: Run a 6-month pilot (customer-facing features) to evaluate latency/cost improvements and quality metrics.
- Suggested model/config: Redwood-managed hosted inference, with option to move to Dedicated later.
- Decision criteria: latency (95p < 200ms), cost per 1k tokens, and quality on the three eval prompt sets you shared.

Can you confirm the stakeholder map on your side (economic buyer, procurement contact, security/legal reviewers) so I can loop in the right people? Also you mentioned procurement will want: SOC 2 Type II, a procurement form, and an SLA conversation (target 99.9%). If there are any additional docs or minimum term requirements, please flag.

I’ve attached the draft SOW we discussed and a short mutual-action plan. Once I have the stakeholders I’ll open an internal procurement exception request for any discount / SLA asks.

Next steps: 1) Send stakeholder list & procurement contact, 2) I’ll request internal approvals for the 20% pilot discount & SLA exception, 3) schedule follow-up demo with Maya and Tom next week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0142

Attachments: SOW-Acme-v1.pdf (draft), MutualActionPlan-Acme.md

From: Jane Thompson <jane.thompson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that looks right. Stakeholder map on our side: 
- Tom Harris (Tom.Harris@acme.com) — CFO / economic buyer
- Maya Li (maya.li@acme.com) — Head of ML / technical buyer (will run the evals)
- Sam Patel (procurement@acme.com) — Procurement contact
- Legal & Security review: legal@acme.com and security-team@acme.com (I can introduce once we have internal approvals)

Procurement notes: they typically require SOC 2 Type II, a completed procurement form (I attached the one procurement uses), and confirmation on SLA. For this pilot they’re asking if we can get a 20% discount off list and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

We’re happy to move quickly — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 and a standard DPA? If so I’ll loop in Maya and Tom for a short technical review next week.

Thanks,
Jane
Director of Product, Acme Corp

Attachments: procurement-form-acme.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 13:35:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks — procurement exception request (20% discount + 99.9% SLA)

Team —

Forwarding Acme’s ask. Quick summary: potential mid-market expansion deal, asking for a 20% pilot discount and a 99.9% SLA. They require SOC 2 Type II and a procurement form. Deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/ACME-2026-003.

Requesting: 
- Aditya: approval for a one-time 20% pilot discount (term: 6 months pilot only)
- Neha (Legal): review standard DPA & confirm any contractual concerns on SLA / discounts; advise on redline timeline
- Monica (Security): confirm we can provide SOC 2 evidence and any additional security controls they’ll ask for (pen test, data residency)
- Lauren / Rishi (Sales Ops): confirm pricing impact & whether we can do a one-off pricing exception in the billing flow.

Attachments: SOW-Acme-v1.pdf, procurement-form-acme.xlsx

Can you all reply with approval / questions by EOD Monday? Acme is keen to schedule the technical review next Wed if we can move this fast.

—Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks — procurement exception request (20% discount + 99.9% SLA)

Marissa / Aditya —

I can review but a couple of initial notes: 
- DPA & SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report (attach latest). I’ll prepare the DPA template and mark any non-standard clauses.
- SLA: 99.9% for hosted is aggressive for a pilot; we should cap any contractual SLA commitment for pilot phase and instead offer a commercial credit schedule that limits exposure. Legal prefers a capped SLA liability (e.g., cap at subscription fees for the pilot period).
- Discount: I need to confirm with finance, but legal does not object to a 20% pilot discount if it’s time-limited and documented in SOW/addendum.

I’ll draft a short redline and circulate by EOD Tuesday. Please route any procurement forms to legal@redwood.com.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - SOC2 + security notes

Marissa —

We can provide our SOC 2 Type II report (see attached SOC2-report-2025.pdf). Before we sign off on an SLA exception, please confirm: 
- Data flows: will Acme send any sensitive PII? If yes, we need scoping info.
- Pen test: procurement sometimes asks for a pen test attestation — we can provide our latest pen-test summary and remediation status.
- Data residency: if they require EU/region residency we may need Dedicated or Private deployment; for a US-based pilot hosted option is OK.

If Acme accepts the pilot constraints (time-limited discount, liability cap, and standard DPA), security is comfortable moving forward. I’ll pull the pen-test summary and share by EOD.

—Monica
Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-report-2025.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: procurement exception request — Acme (20% pilot discount)

Marissa / team —

Approve the 20% pilot discount for Acme for a 6-month pilot, conditioned on: 
1) Legal signoff on DPA and capped SLA liability for the pilot period
2) Security confirms SOC 2 and pen-test attestation (no open critical findings)
3) Pricing/Finance (Lauren/Rishi) confirm net impact and that discount is recorded as a one-off line item.

Assuming the above, proceed to confirm the pilot offer with Acme and schedule the technical review with Maya & Tom. If any of the three conditions fail, escalate back to me.

—Aditya
VP, Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Thompson <jane.thompson@acme.com>, Maya Li <maya.li@acme.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme - discovery recap, stakeholder map & procurement asks

Hi Jane / Maya / Tom —

Quick update from our side: we’ve initiated the internal approvals. Aditya has approved a 20% one-time pilot discount for a 6-month pilot, pending Legal and Security signoff on DPA / SLA caps and confirmation there are no open critical security findings. Neha will circulate a DPA redline; Monica attached our SOC 2 report and will share the pen-test summary this afternoon. Lauren/Rishi are confirming billing flow for a one-off discount.

Next steps on timing: if Acme can confirm availability for a 60-minute technical review with Maya & Tom, we can run that as early as next Wednesday. After the technical review we’ll finalize the SOW and procurement form and route to legal for signature.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW-Acme-v1.pdf, SOC2-report-2025.pdf
